breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory preamble instruction for defining the grid (point-based, dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)) which conflicted with the later, correct instruction for a periodic grid (dx=1/Nx). The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect preamble instruction. The agent correctly ignored the contradictory instruction and generated a specification using only the correct periodic grid definition ('Use a uniform periodic grid with Nx = 256 points, dx = 1/Nx'), thus resolving the inconsistency.
